title: teramnus repens
intro: Teramnus repens, commonly known as Hog Pea or Catgut, is a perennial legume native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Teramnus repens include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve fever, and treat various respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
